Subject: Request: evaluation credits + dedicated pilot for upcoming RFP

Hi Ben,

Hope you9re well. We9re running a tight head-to-head evaluation as part of an RFP (MarketFlow Q4 search re-rank project) against two other vendors and wanted to check whether Redwood can provide a short, focused pilot for side-by-side comparison.

High-level ask: 1) ~1M tokens of hosted credits or equivalent compute access, 2) 2-week dedicated slot for controlled latency/throughput testing, 3) short onboarding + support during the trial window. Evaluation will focus on latency at 1k request/sec, A/B quality with our prompt set, and embedding accuracy for 4k documents.

This pilot is decisive for us and the customer procurement team needs a documented offer for the RFP by Oct 14. Are there standard packages or promotional structures you can propose? If you have a short template for pilot terms we can include in the RFP, that would help.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask and the evaluation brief. We9re interested in supporting a side-by-side pilot and can propose a short, timeboxed package calibrated for competitive benchmarks. Quick proposal below: 

- Credits: 500k hosted-token credit pool (to be used across generation & embedding).
- Dedicated: 1-week reserved lightweight Dedicated slot (single-GPU equivalent) for controlled latency profiling.
- Support: 2x onboarding sessions + 5 business days of live support during the trial.
